title: Virtual memory fundamentals
objectives: Describe the purpose of virtual memory in providing an abstraction of a large, private address space
Explain the relationship between physical memory and virtual memory

blocks.text: Virtual memory is a memory management technique that gives each process the illusion of working with a large, contiguous, private address space, even though the physical memory may be much smaller. The operating system uses secondary storage (disk) as an extension of main memory, swapping pages in and out as needed.
